  "correction_rules": [
    "When sentiment is negative (≤ 0), reduce forecasted prices by 5-10% to account for downward pressure.",
    "After a price spike (forecast > 70), apply a 3-day mean reversion filter to prevent over-optimism.",
    "If the last 3 days show a downward trend, adjust forecast to align with recent low prices (avoid bullish overcorrection).",
    "For sentiment > 0.5, increase forecast by 3-5% to reflect bullish momentum, but cap at 75.00 to avoid overextension.",
    "If forecast consistently underperforms (error > 3.0) over 3 consecutive days, apply a 2% upward bias correction.",
    "When sentiment is neutral (0.00), use 30-day moving average of true outcomes as baseline for correction.",
    "If forecast is > 75.00 and sentiment is low, reduce by 10% to avoid overvaluing carbon credits in weak sentiment.",
    "For long-term horizon (30d), apply a 10% downward bias if true outcome is consistently below forecast (e.g., > 3 days)."
  ]
}
